text:
tara_csm: FYI - BeaconRetail (midmarket) usage dropped 55% this month, onboarding stuck at 50%. Renewal in ~42 days. We need a quick save play.

mike_support: they filed a ticket about failed scheduled jobs and a surprise invoice spike.

lee_eng: likely cause = batch retries duplicating calls. Can suggest toggling dedupe + lowering concurrency.

sasha_csm: proposed micro-play: 1) 20-30m joint session (billing + config), 2) grant a 7-day stability credit, 3) run micro-eval on 10 prompts pre/post.

billing_bot: Finance pre-approves one-time 7-day credit tied to attendance.

ops_bot: Created task BR-7217 assigned to sasha_csm + lee_eng. Reminder set for 1718958200.

lee_eng: quick config snippet to suggest in the session:
```
batch:
  concurrency: 2
  dedupe_resends: true
  retry_limit: 1
```

sasha_csm: I'll send the short invite now. Keep tone "helpful" not "we'll downgrade". Include the micro-survey after the call.

tara_csm: Perfect. Success criteria: onboarding progress +20% within 14 days OR DAU recovery >15%. If not met, we move to a stepped downgrade path with explicit dates. Update here after the call.
